_comment: CORE's path -> invariant map, consumed by .claude/hooks/guard_paths.py.
This file is the ONLY place project knowledge lives; the hook itself is generic.
Every 'reminder' line must name an invariant that exists in AGENTS.md or
docs/specs/runtime_contracts.md. If a line cannot be traced to one, delete it --
an unfalsifiable reminder is noise that trains agents to skim the real ones.
action: 'context' informs and proceeds | 'ask' prompts the human | 'deny' refuses.

rules.title: Versor closure substrate
reminder: versor_condition(F) < 1e-6 must hold for every runtime field state. Do not weaken the threshold to make a test pass; fix the operator or construction boundary that violated it.
Closure of field transitions is owned solely by algebra/versor.py (_close_applied_versor). No other site may 'fix' it.

The bright line: semantic anchoring preserves versor_condition BY CONSTRUCTION and expresses a cognitive relation. Drift repair restores an invariant a prior function should have preserved -- and is forbidden. Naming must not disguise the distinction.
State the post-change versor_condition value and which assertion it protects. Lane: uv run core test --suite algebra -q

rules.title: Hot path -- normalization forbidden
reminder: Forbidden here: unitize(), normalize(), grade-projection, watchdog normalization, post-hoc algebra fixes.
Allowed normalization boundaries are exhaustive and listed in AGENTS.md: ingest/gate.py, packs/compiler.py, algebra/versor.py, sensorium/*/canonical.py, session/context.py.

If you believe this site needs normalization, the correct change is upstream at a construction boundary, not here. A repair added here restores a versor_condition that a prior function should have preserved -- that is drift repair, and it is forbidden.
Lane: uv run core test --suite algebra -q, plus the lane covering the organ you edited.

rules.title: Vault / teaching learning boundary
reminder: INV-21: only allowlisted modules may call VaultStore.store(...). Never create a parallel memory path.
INV-22 / INV-23: an unmarked pack row and an unmarked store() default to SPECULATIVE. COHERENT requires an explicit stamp -- never a default.
INV-24: every vault.recall callsite is categorized; user-facing evidence must pass min_status=COHERENT.
INV-29: only vault/store.py may transition an epistemic_status.
The boundary is durable vs provisional, not 'everything is proposal-only'. Provisional state may update autonomously iff typed, isolated, replayable, and unable to masquerade as ratified truth.
Lane: uv run core test --suite teaching -q

rules.title: Cognition pipeline -- typed refusal
reminder: INV-34: failures are typed, never silent. Every refusal carries an explicit failing condition and reason. A None ContractAssessment is itself a typed violation. Unresolvable referents refuse rather than fill.
INV-30: the open-world determine() gear constructs only Determined(answer=True) or refuses. It can NEVER assert answer=False. Closed-world entailed-negation needs a distinct type and entry point.
No stochastic generation, hidden LLM fallback, or probabilistic substitute inside the deterministic cognitive path.
Lane: uv run core test --suite cognition -q

rules.title: Pack compilation / serve boundary
reminder: INV-33: serve entrypoints never import draft language trees (packs/he, packs/grc, ...) as Python packages. Runtime packs load only from packs/data/<pack_id>/ via packs.compiler.load_pack.
Pack mutation is proposal-only until reviewed.
Lane: uv run core test --suite packs -q

rules.title: Identity manifold -- wave-only scoring
reminder: INV-32: identity scoring is wave-only. IdentityCheck.check requires an explicit Cl(4,1) wave_field; absence raises typed MissingWaveStateError, malformed fields raise ValueError. No scalar-L2 fallback exists -- do not add one.
Live refusal stays flag-gated (identity_wave_gate, default off, not authorized). Do not flip the default.

rules.title: Runtime recall must stay exact
reminder: Runtime recall remains exact and deterministic. Do not add cosine similarity, ANN / approximate nearest neighbor, HNSW, or embedding ranking as runtime memory truth. Use exact CGA recall primitives only.
This is the AGENTS.md 'Exact recall' invariant. It is unnumbered but non-negotiable; an approximate recall path is a silent correctness regression that no lane will fail on.
Lane: uv run core test --suite algebra -q (vault recall + Rust parity).

rules.title: Governance artifact
reminder: This file is load-bearing governance, not documentation. Changing it changes what every agent on this repo is permitted to do.
Before a new ADR or invariant: grep ALL existing ADRs and code for prior art. Numbering is sequential in docs/adr/ADR-XXXX-<slug>.md (docs/decisions/ is a legacy stub -- do not add there).
Provider-file policy: CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md stay under 600 bytes, point at AGENTS.md as canonical, and introduce no provider-only truth.
A new INV-nn added here must be falsifiable and must have a test that fails when it is violated. If you cannot name that test, you are adding prose, not an invariant.
Lane: uv run core test --suite smoke -q at minimum; tests/test_architectural_invariants.py covers the structural pins.
